name: Web-Check
description: Website and domain recon (DNS, registration, certificates, archive history, headers, trackers, tech stack) through a self-hosted Web-Check instance. Produces unverified observations only.
egress_note: Requests go to the configured instance, which then queries DNS resolvers and public datasets (RDAP/WHOIS, Wayback CDX, crt.sh, CertSpotter, HackerTarget, Tranco, IP geolocation). Page-tier checks also send ordinary HTTP/TLS requests to the target; they run only with contact_target: true.
risk_note: Infrastructure observations are not attribution. DNS, hosting, trackers and registration data change and can be shared, proxied or spoofed.
